meta.name: niche-researcher
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "research a niche community", "deep-dive a subculture", or "find micro-niches for a brand"; produces a community map, culture decode (language, norms, taboos), key-voice tiers, content ecosystem, brand-fit score, and a phased entry strategy. Not for finding specific creators to contract — use influencer-discovery.

copy.tagline: 深度调研小众社群，制定品牌入场策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果品牌想进入某个小众圈层但不知如何下手
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into niche communities and craft entry strategies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your brand wants to enter a niche community but doesn't know where to start

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你研究一个小众社群或亚文化，输出一份报告，内容包括社群地图、文化解码（语言、规矩、禁忌）、关键人物分级、内容生态、品牌契合度评分和分阶段入场策略。
howto.when: 当你要求“研究某个小众社群”、“深入分析某个亚文化”或“为品牌寻找微细分市场”时触发。

say.text: 研究一下#BookTok社群，看看出版品牌怎么入场。
say.note: Claude 会输出一份完整的社群研究报告。

say.text: 深入分析滑板亚文化，找出关键人物和内容趋势。
say.note: Claude 会解码文化并分级关键声音。

say.text: 为我的护肤品牌找几个高互动的小众社群。
say.note: Claude 会识别微社群并评估品牌契合度。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will research a niche community or subculture and produce a dossier including community map, culture decode (language, norms, taboos), key-voice tiers, content ecosystem, brand-fit score, and a phased entry strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "research a niche community", "deep-dive a subculture", or "find micro-niches for a brand".

say_en.text: Research the #BookTok community and identify opportunities for a publishing brand.
say_en.note: Claude will output a full niche research dossier.

say_en.text: Deep-dive into skateboarding subculture — key voices and content trends.
say_en.note: Claude will decode culture and tier key voices.

say_en.text: Find high-engagement micro-niches for my skincare brand.
say_en.note: Claude will identify micro-communities and assess brand fit.
